description: A production planning manager must schedule the repair of an automated palletizer and finalize the operating, shipment-rerouting, and safety controls, with input from maintenance, logistics, and safety.

shared_context.S1: Automated Palletizer P-7 serves the finished-goods area and is due for gearbox maintenance this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final decision on the maintenance window and the operating plan during the work.
shared_context.S3: P-7 normally transfers completed pallets to Dock 3, and the finished-goods area has limited space for manually staged pallets.
shared_context.S4: The weekly planning meeting includes a routine check with maintenance, logistics, and safety before equipment work is scheduled.

PF1.text: Raj's vibration assessment found a cracked gearbox bearing that could seize under load; he recommends starting the replacement Saturday at 06:00, the work requires exactly 6 hours, and P-7 must not operate during the repair. He completed the assessment yesterday but has not yet attached it to the maintenance work order.

PF2.text: Marta's carrier confirmation shows that exactly 22 finished-goods pallets must be ready for Monday's 06:00 pickup, and the carrier can collect them at Dock 1 instead of Dock 3 if the reroute is booked by Friday afternoon. She received the confirmation by email but has not entered it in the shipping board.

PF3.text: Jonas's safety review requires an independent lockout verification before gearbox work and an 8-meter exclusion zone around P-7 while the guarding is open. He completed the review during yesterday's floor walk but has not issued the permit addendum.

acceptance_conditions: The gearbox repair must be scheduled to start Saturday at 06:00.
The maintenance window must last exactly 6 hours.
Palletizer P-7 must remain out of operation during the repair.
Exactly 22 Monday shipment pallets must be rerouted to Dock 1.
An order confirmation for the Dock 1 reroute must be booked by Friday afternoon.
An independent lockout verification must be required before work begins.
An 8-meter exclusion zone must be established around P-7.
The gearbox bearing assessment must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['maintenance_window_start'] == 'Saturday 06:00' and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed
content_checks.C2: decisions['maintenance_window_hours'] == 6 and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed
content_checks.C3: decisions['palletizer_operating_during_repair'] == False and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed
content_checks.C4: decisions['monday_pallets_rerouted_to_dock_1'] == 22 and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in revealed
content_checks.C5: decisions['independent_lockout_verification_required'] == True and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in revealed
content_checks.C6: decisions['exclusion_zone_meters'] == 8 and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in revealed
content_checks.C7: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in revealed and any(c['type'] == 'dock_1_reroute_booking' and c['target'] == 'Monday shipment' and c['detail'] == 'Book 22 pallets at Dock 1 by Friday afternoon' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in revealed and any(c['type'] == 'lockout_verification' and c['target'] == 'P-7 gearbox repair' and c['detail'] == 'Independent lockout verification before work begins' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in revealed and any(c['type'] == 'exclusion_zone' and c['target'] == 'P-7' and c['detail'] == 'Establish 8-meter exclusion zone while guarding is open' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The cracked bearing changes the repair plan to a Saturday 06:00 start, an exact 6-hour outage, and a prohibition on operating P-7 during the repair.
The carrier confirmation changes the shipment plan to exactly 22 pallets at Dock 1 and requires booking that reroute by Friday afternoon.
The safety review changes the work controls to mandatory independent lockout verification and an exact 8-meter exclusion zone around P-7 while guarding is open.
